resources.string: Your phone on your car screen
Looking for your car…\n\nOpen DaBYDlink Car on the car screen, and make sure the phone and the car are on the same Wi-Fi (for example, the car joined your phone\'s hotspot).
Or connect by the address shown on the car screen
If Android says \"Restricted setting\": open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then turn it on again.
When the car is moving, YouTube and other video apps are hidden on the car screen. Maps, music and calls keep working.

• Turn your phone sideways for full-screen YouTube and Maps on the car display.
• Sound plays through the car speakers over Bluetooth, so pair your phone with the car once.
• Keep the phone charging; the screen stays on (dimmed) while mirroring.
• Use 5 GHz Wi-Fi/hotspot for the smoothest picture.
Lets DaBYDlink replay your taps and swipes from the car screen on this phone, and see which app is open so video can be hidden while driving. Nothing is read from your screen content.
